amp2_negative_meta_knowledge.rule: Designed attacks are hypotheses/tests until executed; never count an attack design as a falsified assumption.
Large counts of alternatives, tests, contradictions or work units increase search breadth but do not confer Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
A prior decision may be overturned only with scoped evidence; the historical aggregate count of 16 overturns is not enough to reconstruct which decisions changed.
Contradictions must remain explicit unresolved objects until evidence resolves them; aggregate count 30 must not be converted into invented contradiction contents.
A Pareto frontier is only recoverable if the candidates, dimensions and ranking evidence survive. The historical filename alone does not preserve the frontier.
Exact historical identifiers such as NK-C-### or CR-C-### are evidence identities. Never synthesize replacements and claim they are the originals.
